accepted: One authored rescue-PFD asset atomically replaces all four procedural vest layers on the guide and four crew avatars.

A four-panel front, thin back, fitted side wings, continuous shoulder bands, pockets, front entry, webbing, buckles, eight adjustment points, quick-release rescue belt and tether ring are represented as separate source-art construction.
Project-owned 1K ripstop albedo, normal and AO/roughness maps replace flat shell colors; all five material slots persist their Nanite permutations.
All five production MetaHuman wrappers select the asset and keep its origin exactly on the solved torso through the audited roster pose.
The PFD is collisionless and does not alter body animation, seat mass, D3/D4 deformation, rescue, swimmer or progression authority.
rejected_or_open: The swept shoulder transition and broad front-panel surfacing remain visibly procedural at portrait distance and are not final hero photoreal art.
Crew seating, hand and paddle contact, gaze, facial performance and wetsuit/body deformation remain visibly synthetic.
Raft highlights, boulder, water, foam and aerosol, shoreline, terrain, foliage and lighting remain below the requested photoreal bar.
No named guide or art reviewer has approved rescue construction fidelity or final appearance.
The capture is not approved for marketing, store, trailer, press-kit or release-media use.
